question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82ca52f4bc6c2b47964a87b64c41fd7900f7ba67cea31a86b20a9c2f8e8b4b01.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23f0e072e7bec6dcfb0307ceb8e82a0a11522aafc13b0d0ff7fc1de17b7e0eab.png] is rotating horizontal and vertical alternatively. And the number of line on it [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5963e543934fc585ce6c9a7e79b5a979fc1f84b7bd7270331adce9f42c52bd6.png] is increasing by one in each successive image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66eab4a6f6aaf282bcd62770111ff363bcda763136487586b756e229a665d5ee.png] 

So, the answer image will be placed in 5th position.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
